sequences.title: Confirming an RBridge Neighbor with TRILL Hellos

intro.quote: The determination of adjacencies on links is made using TRILL Hellos (see Section 8), an optional MTU test (see Section 5), and, optionally, BFD (see Section 6) and/or other connectivity tests.

steps.explain: RBridge A sends a TRILL Hello. On a LAN, the Hello lists RBridge B in a TRILL Neighbor TLV; on a point-to-point link, it carries a Three-Way Handshake TLV with B's System ID and Extended Circuit ID.

cite.quote: A1. Receive a TRILL Hello (other than an A0 event) such that: - If received on an Ethernet port, it was received in the Designated VLAN. - If received for a broadcast LAN adjacency, it contains a TRILL Neighbor TLV that explicitly lists the receiving port's (SNPA) address. - If received for a point-to-point adjacency, it contains a Three-Way Handshake TLV with the receiver's System ID and Extended Circuit ID.

steps.explain: RBridge B returns a TRILL Hello. Its TRILL Neighbor TLV lists RBridge A on a LAN, or its Three-Way Handshake TLV carries A's System ID and Extended Circuit ID on a point-to-point link.

cite.quote: A1. Receive a TRILL Hello (other than an A0 event) such that: - If received on an Ethernet port, it was received in the Designated VLAN. - If received for a broadcast LAN adjacency, it contains a TRILL Neighbor TLV that explicitly lists the receiving port's (SNPA) address. - If received for a point-to-point adjacency, it contains a Three-Way Handshake TLV with the receiver's System ID and Extended Circuit ID.

intro.quote: The BFD-Enabled TLVs in TRILL Hellos will look like the following:

fields.name: Type
fields.explain: Identifies the TLV as BFD Enabled.

fields.name: Length
fields.explain: Specifies the TLV length as three times the number of topology and protocol pairs.

cite.quote: Length will be 3 times the number of topology and protocol pairs in the TLV.

fields.name: RESV
fields.explain: Holds reserved space in the TLV.

fields.name: MT ID
fields.explain: Identifies the topology and is zero unless multi-topology support is being used.

cite.quote: MT ID is a topology ID [RFC5120] that will be zero unless multi-topology is being supported [MT].

fields.name: NLPID
fields.explain: Identifies the network-layer protocol and uses 0xC0 for TRILL.

cite.quote: NLPID is a Network Layer Protocol ID [RFC6328] and will be 0xC0 for TRILL, but additional topology and protocol pairs could conceivably be listed.

fields.name: topology/NLPID pairs
fields.explain: Carries optional additional topology and protocol pairs.
